      <title>Collision of two trains in Egypt kills at least seven</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/08/egypt-two-trains-deadly-collision</link>
      <description><p>President orders prompt investigation after one train derails in collision in al-Ayyat about 50km from Cairo</p><p>Seven people were killed and at least 125 injured when two trains collided on Sunday south of the Egyptian capital, Cairo, officials said.</p><p>The crash occurred in al-Ayyat district in Giza province, about 50km (30 miles) south of Cairo, when a train travelling to Fayoum province crashed into the rear of a train heading to the southern province of Aswan, according to the transport ministry.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/08/egypt-two-trains-deadly-collision">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <title>Kenyan doomsday sect leader jailed for 200 years for murder of 190 children</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/06/kenyan-doomsday-sect-leader-jailed-murders-paul-mackenzie</link>
      <description><p>Paul Mackenzie convicted over deaths of children and one adult after followers were ordered to starve themselves and their families</p><p>The leader of a Kenyan doomsday sect has been sentenced to 200 years in prison for the murders of 190 children and one adult in one of the world’s worst cult disasters in recent history.</p><p>The sentence, comprising 100 years for murder by starvation and 100 years by direct homicide, came two weeks after the court in Kenya’s coastal city of Mombasa <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/oct/19/kenya-starvation-cult-leader-guilty-murder-190-children">found the cult leader guilty</a> of the crimes.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/06/kenyan-doomsday-sect-leader-jailed-murders-paul-mackenzie">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <title>ANC faces bruising defeat in South African local elections with 80% of ballots counted</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/06/anc-faces-defeat-south-african-local-elections</link>
      <description><p>Former liberation movement’s share of national vote almost 14 percentage points below 2021 result</p><p>The African National Congress is on course to suffer a bruising defeat in South Africa’s local elections, with the once dominant party of Nelson Mandela falling to under a third of the vote nationally with more than 80% of ballots counted.</p><p>Wednesday’s fragmented vote marks another stage in the decline of the ANC, which has led national governments since the end of white minority apartheid rule in 1994. High unemployment, crime, corruption and poor local service delivery have all contributed to <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/04/anc-south-africa-local-elections-water-outages-power-cuts">voters turning away from the party</a>.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/06/anc-faces-defeat-south-african-local-elections">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/04/british-healthcare-worker-ebola-evacuated-drc-to-uk-document-shows</link>
      <description><p>Patient is ⁠in ​stable condition and will be transferred to a specialist ‘high consequence’ infectious disease unit</p><p>A British healthcare worker with Ebola is being evacuated from the Democratic Republic of the Congo to the UK for medical treatment, it has been confirmed.</p><p>“A British citizen currently in the DR Congo has tested positive for Ebola,” a spokesperson for the UK government said in a statement on Wednesday. “The UK has well-established procedures for dealing with cases like this, and those processes have been activated … The risk to the UK public from Ebola remains low.”</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/04/british-healthcare-worker-ebola-evacuated-drc-to-uk-document-shows">Continue reading...</a></description>

<rss version="2.0" xmlns:atom="http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom" xmlns:media="http://search.yahoo.com/mrss/" xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><channel><language>en</language><title>France 24 - International breaking news, top stories and headlines</title><description>Breaking news and world news from France 24 on Business, Sports, Culture. Video news. News from the US, Europe, Asia Pacific, Africa, Middle East, America</description><link>https://www.france24.com/en/</link><lastBuildDate>Tue, 10 Nov 2026 13:00:10 GMT</lastBuildDate><atom:link href="https://www.france24.com/en/rss" rel="self" type="application/rss+xml"/><item><category></category><title>Ukraine peace talks: Who is sitting at the negotiating table – and why it matters</title><link>https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261110-ukraine-peace-talks-who-is-sitting-at-the-negotiating-table-%E2%80%93-and-why-it-matters</link><description>
Three-way talks between Russia, Ukraine and the United States opened Tuesday in the United Arab Emirates, as Washington made a renewed push to end the war that followed Moscow's invasion of its neighbour nearly five years ago. As these two days of talks in Abu Dhabi get underway, the negotiators that each country has chosen to send tell us most of what we need to know about what will be discussed, as FRANCE 24's International Affairs Commentator Douglas Herbert explains.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/ebe437c2-dcfb-11f1-bf82-695cb59fade5/w:1024/p:16x9/EN-20261110-120140-120634-CS.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/ebe437c2-dcfb-11f1-bf82-695cb59fade5/w:1024/p:16x9/EN-20261110-120140-120634-CS.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">f0f3d4b6-dcfb-11f1-9df2-d7d1f9da25a2</guid><pubDate>Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:45:29 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item><item><category></category><title>Dana White: UFC chief declines Trump’s White House job offer</title><link>https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261110-dana-white-ufc-chief-declines-trump-s-white-house-job-offer</link><description>
Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC) chief Dana White made a surprise appearance at the White House on Monday to turn down Donald Trump’s offer of a job as the White House press secretary, saying he has “zero political aspirations”. Trump stunned the world on November 7 when he said on social media that he had offered White the job, only to claim a day later that he was "only kidding”.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/b7fd633a-dcfa-11f1-a0c4-3f371022a770/w:1024/p:16x9/Dana-White-thumbnail.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/b7fd633a-dcfa-11f1-a0c4-3f371022a770/w:1024/p:16x9/Dana-White-thumbnail.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">9007bf56-dcfa-11f1-93f0-73ef5755524e</guid><pubDate>Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:39:53 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item><item><category></category><title>New Israel parliament to be sworn in as Eisenkot works to form new govt</title><link>https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261110-new-israel-parliament-to-be-sworn-in-as-eisenkot-works-to-form-new-govt</link><description>
Israel's new parliament will be sworn on Tuesday, November 10, with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu set to lose his majority as rival Gadi Eisenkot works to form a new government. The opposition hopes to use its newfound legislative power to move quickly on key priorities, including a commission to investigate security failures under Netanyahu that allowed the October 7, 2023 attack by Hamas. FRANCE 24's correspondent in Jerusalem Noga Tarnopolsky has more.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/ca01015e-dcf5-11f1-bb13-29048b396e03/w:1024/p:16x9/capture-a1c9673b.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/ca01015e-dcf5-11f1-bb13-29048b396e03/w:1024/p:16x9/capture-a1c9673b.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">f9ad13ee-dcf4-11f1-b6f4-333395c1bad3</guid><pubDate>Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:22:39 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item><item><category></category><title>California voters reject measure to tax the wealth of billionaires</title><link>https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261110-california-voters-reject-measure-to-tax-the-wealth-of-billionaires</link><description>
California voters have rejected a first-in-the-nation tax on the net worth of billionaires following a contentious ballot fight that generated huge spending by some prominent tech leaders eager to stop their taxes from going up. The measure would have imposed a one-time 5% tax on the wealth of Californians whose net worth exceeds $1 billion. FRANCE 24's correspondent in Los Angeles Loic Pialat has more.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/73384700-dcf6-11f1-ad84-5f54d898a954/w:1024/p:16x9/capture-9ee8e9dd.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/73384700-dcf6-11f1-ad84-5f54d898a954/w:1024/p:16x9/capture-9ee8e9dd.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">b98f79e0-dcf5-11f1-8007-fbcd23925f41</guid><pubDate>Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:20:09 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item><item><category>Press Review</category><title>Teddy Riner: From French Olympic judo champion to presidential candidate</title><link>https://www.france24.com/en/tv-shows/press-review/20261110-teddy-riner-from-french-olympic-judo-champion-to-presidential-candidate</link><description>
PRESS REVIEW – Tuesday, November 10: French Olympic judo champion Teddy Riner announces he will run for president in next year's French elections. But how serious is his bid? Also, a new government directive in France says schoolchildren must participate in Remembrance Day commemorations – but the unions are not happy. British comedian Russell Brand is sentenced to 10 years in prison for rape and sexual assault. Finally, we bring you the best of the memes on Nvidia's Jensen Huang.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/1708045e-dcd6-11f1-b28f-5f54d898a954/w:1024/p:16x9/Anglais-2026-11-10T06-20-10-489Z.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/1708045e-dcd6-11f1-b28f-5f54d898a954/w:1024/p:16x9/Anglais-2026-11-10T06-20-10-489Z.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">1aee3aa2-dcd6-11f1-a8dd-a76ba7c38a52</guid><pubDate>Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:16:17 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>Dheepthika LAURENT</dc:creator></item></channel></rss>

      <description>Light travels through conventional optical fibres at about 200,000km per second – about two-thirds the speed it travels in a vacuum – because the signals are passing through solid glass.
When vast amounts of data are exchanged between computing centres hundreds or thousands of kilometres apart, this difference amounts to a substantial delay.
Now, Chinese researchers have unveiled optical fibre that replaces the solid glass core with air, cutting the data transmission delay by about 30 per cent...</description>

<![CDATA[ Latest from Space.com ]]> https://www.space.com/feeds.xml Tue, 10 Nov 2026 13:00:00 +0000 en <![CDATA[ Total solar eclipse 2027 vs 2028 — Which one should you choose, Egypt or Australia? ]]> For those who want to experience a total solar eclipse, the next two years present the best kind of problem. On Aug. 2, 2027, the so-called "eclipse of the century" will sweep across southern Spain, North Africa and the Middle East, bringing more than six minutes of totality to parts of Egypt. Then, on July 22, 2028, another exceptionally long total solar eclipse will cross Australia, putting the remote Outback and Sydney Harbor in the path of the moon's dark central shadow before it reaches New Zealand's beautiful South Island.

Both eclipses will be spectacular, and both will require careful planning, yet they promise very different experiences. The 2027 event combines over six minutes of totality with some of the very best weather prospects possible, while 2028 offers over five minutes of totality above some of the world's most famous wildernesses and cityscapes.

Eclipse chasing requires careful planning and dedication, but also significant funds. If you can only choose one, which should it be?

2027 total solar eclipse: pros and cons

On paper, 2027 is difficult to beat. Maximum totality on Aug. 2 will last about 6 minutes, 23 seconds, making it the longest totality on land since 1991 and until 2114. The path of totality will cross southern Spain and Gibraltar before sweeping across Morocco, Algeria, Tunisia, Libya, Egypt, Sudan, Saudi Arabia, Yemen, Somalia and the Chagos Islands. About 88.9 million people live in its path, according to Time and Date. It will dominate the news for weeks.

For Europeans, southern Spain is the obvious easy option. Tarifa, at the country's southern tip, will see about 4 minutes, 39 seconds of totality, while the U.K. Overseas Territory of Gibraltar gets about 4 minutes, 25 seconds. Travel farther east and the duration increases, with Sfax in Tunisia getting around 5 minutes, 41 seconds and locations in Egypt experiencing more than six minutes. Weather prospects generally improve, too, as the path crosses the deserts of North Africa.

Egypt is the headline destination. Luxor will see about 6 minutes, 20 seconds of totality near midday, with Karnak Temple, the Valley of the Kings, and some of the world's greatest ancient monuments nearby. The climatic odds are excellent, with clouds extremely rare in early August. That combination of a very long totality, ancient landscapes and a very high probability of a clear sky makes 2027's path of totality highly unusual.

But there are downsides. Temperatures around Luxor can exceed 105°F (41°C) in August, a dust storm is not impossible, and totality occurs shortly after 1 p.m. when the sun (and moon) will be high overhead — making photography very difficult. Demand is already intense, making organized trips expensive. Spain will be considerably easier and probably cheaper for European eclipse chasers, but at the expense of roughly two minutes of totality — and slightly less favorable weather prospects.

2028 total solar eclipse: pros and cons

If 2027 is about extreme duration, 2028 is about choice. On July 22, 2028, a path of totality will cross the Cocos Islands, Christmas Island, Australia, from northwest to southeast — passing directly over Sydney — before continuing across the Tasman Sea to New Zealand's South Island. That's about 6.3 million people, according to Time and Date. This will be an exclusive eclipse experienced by relatively few people, certainly when compared to the eclipses in 2024, 2026 and 2027.

Maximum totality will last 5 minutes and 10 seconds in the remote Kimberley region of Western Australia. That's more than a minute shorter than 2027, but still exceptionally long by total solar eclipse standards (most last about two minutes). More importantly, the Australian Outback has excellent climatic prospects. Historical cloudiness on July 22 is around 8% at Purnululu (Bungle Bungles) close to the point of greatest eclipse in Western Australia and 19% at Karlu Karlu (Devil's Marbles) in the Northern Territory, making Australia's interior an attractive destination for serious eclipse chasers. Temperatures will be around 86°F (30°C) in July.

Then there's Sydney. Australia's largest city will experience about 3 minutes, 45 seconds of totality, its first total solar eclipse since 1857. Sydney Opera House and Harbor Bridge beneath a totally eclipsed sun could produce some of the decade's defining astronomical images, while millions of people experiencing totality together should create an extraordinary atmosphere. Temperatures will be around 62.6°F (17°C).

A compromise is weather. Historical cloudiness in Sydney is around 43%, which is good odds for most eclipses — and July is known for clear weather. But in 2028, anyone prioritizing their chances of a clear totality will be tempted by a (albeit pricier) trip to the Outback. For Europeans, reaching Australia also comes with considerable cost and time. The huge number of hotels in Sydney could keep accommodation relatively competitive, but the long flight means it makes little sense to travel there for only a few days. For many international eclipse chasers, 2028 will naturally become an expensive one- or two-week trip.

Don't forget the night sky

There's another reason to think beyond those few minutes of darkness. With the right planning, an eclipse trip can also become an extraordinary astronomy vacation (tip: come a week before the eclipse for the darkest evening skies). Here, 2028 offers visitors from Europe and North America something very different — the Southern Hemisphere night sky.

July is a superb time to see the bright central regions of the Milky Way from dark locations in Australia. The Southern Cross, or Crux, is one of the southern sky's defining sights, with Alpha and Beta Centauri nearby. Omega Centauri, the largest and brightest globular cluster visible from Earth, is another showpiece, while the Eta Carinae region offers one of the richest sections of the Milky Way for binoculars and small telescopes.

There are other reasons to extend the trip. A partial lunar eclipse occurs on July 6-7, 2028, while the Southern Delta Aquariid meteor shower peaks around July 28 — a week after the eclipse, during a first-quarter moon — and is particularly well seen from the Southern Hemisphere. Add Australia's world-class dark skies, and a trip into the Outback could become as much about stargazing as the eclipse itself.

The 2027 eclipse has fewer night-sky extras. The Delta Aquariid meteor shower peaks a few days before the eclipse — in dark, moonless skies — while Jupiter will dominate the western sky shortly after sunset. However, anyone traveling from the Northern Hemisphere will largely see a familiar celestial hemisphere. Australia offers a genuinely different sky experience.

City, desert or wilderness?

Perhaps the most useful way to choose between these eclipses is not to compare their durations, but to imagine where you would most like to be when the moon's shadow arrives.

In 2027, the decision largely comes down to how far along the eclipse track you want to travel. Stay in southern Spain for convenience and around four minutes of totality, head into Tunisia for longer totality and excellent weather prospects, or go all-in on Egypt for more than six minutes beneath almost cloudless desert skies — and bragging rights among eclipse chasers. It's an eclipse that can be combined with beaches, Roman ruins, North African cities or the temples and, of course, the tombs of ancient Egypt.

In 2028, the contrast is even greater. Sydney offers a communal total solar eclipse — a busy "we eclipse" — with millions watching daylight disappear above one of the world's great cities. Head thousands of miles away into the Australian interior and the same event becomes a lonely "me eclipse" in the wilderness, with up to five minutes of totality above an immense Outback landscape. Continue to New Zealand, and there's yet another possibility — a shorter totality with the sun much lower in the afternoon sky.

Which total solar eclipse should you choose?

If your priority is purely totality duration, 2027 marginally wins. More than six minutes of totality combined with extraordinarily reliable weather is a rare combination. There's a good reason Aug. 2, 2027 is being marketed as the "eclipse of the century." But if you've always wanted to visit Australia or New Zealand, the 2028 eclipse is an extraordinary excuse to finally go, in addition to experiencing a long totality.

Choose the trip you most want to take, then find the best possible place for you within the path of totality. After all, no total solar eclipse lasts long enough, and most eclipse chasers struggle to recall exactly how long totality lasted. They're just left with the same question as always — when is the next one?

]]> <![CDATA[ NASA's twin ESCAPADE Mars probes slingshot around Earth in unprecedented double 'gravity assist' ]]> Twin NASA spacecraft are wrapping up a year-long escapade, ready to make a beeline to the Red Planet.

The Escape and Plasma Acceleration and Dynamics Explorers (ESCAPADE) spacecraft launched in November 2025 on the second-ever flight of Blue Origin's New Glenn rocket. But rather than head straight to Mars, the two spacecraft dawdled through a looping trajectory. Now, they are back in Earth's neighborhood where they tackled a crucial engine burn unusually close to Earth that — if all goes well — will set them on track for Mars.

"No NASA mission has ever done this before," said Rob Lillis, a planetary and space physicist at the University of California, Berkeley and principal investigator of the ESCAPADE mission. "For most missions, it just isn't necessary."

That's because traditionally NASA's Mars missions have been carefully choreographed within cosmic launch constraints, leaving Earth during a brief window of planetary alignment that only occurs every 26 months. ESCAPADE was meant to launch in October 2024, when Earth and Mars were favorably aligned, but delays with the New Glenn rocket forced the mission to sit out the precious launch window.

Rather than wait to launch this fall, NASA decided to try something new. ESCAPADE mission planners designed a "loitering" orbit, shaped like a kidney bean. It called for the twin probes to loop through that trajectory to be back at Earth in early November 2026, ready to continue on to Mars.

Once they arrived, however, the twin probes faced a major hurdle: Each had to perfectly execute an engine burn within Earth's gravity well. The maneuver is similar to the slingshot flybys that spacecraft regularly conduct to adjust their trajectories — but here, the probes had to fire their engines to amp up the effect of the burn rather than acting alone.

The first spacecraft tackled the feat on Nov. 7; the second did so on Monday (Nov. 9). And according to NASA, the burns went perfectly. "This is the first time NASA has used a powered Earth flyby to propel a spacecraft toward Mars, and we've now executed this maneuver twice, flawlessly, in just two days," Asal Naseri, acting associate flight director for NASA's Heliophysics Division said in a statement.

After just a few minor course corrections, ESCAPADE will be sailing toward a September 2027 Mars arrival.

A scenic detour

The twin ESCAPADE spacecraft have made the most of their extended tour. Each spacecraft is about the size of two refrigerators and equipped with three scientific instruments and a couple cameras. All are tailored for studying the strange magnetic field of Mars, which is created both globally by charged particles from the sun interacting with the atmosphere and locally by areas of highly magnetic crust.

Earth's magnetic field is much stronger and generated by the planet's core. But it too is affected by the solar wind, as scientists call the constant stream of charged particles flowing off the sun and across space. On the side of Earth opposite the sun, the solar wind stretches the magnetic field to form an elongated tail structure, like a terrestrial windsock.

A range of missions have studied this magnetotail at various points up to nearly 800,000 miles (1.27 million kilometers) away from Earth, but beyond that, it has been a mystery. Conveniently, the two ESCAPADE spacecraft traveled through the structure over the course of about 10 days early last year at a much greater distance from Earth — some 1.19 million miles (1.91 million km) away.

]]> <![CDATA[ On this day in space! Nov. 9, 1967: NASA launches the Saturn V moon rocket for the first time on Apollo 4, but no astronauts were aboard ]]>

On Nov. 9, 1967, NASA launched the powerful new Saturn V rocket on its maiden voyage.

The Saturn V moon rocket was 363 feet tall. That's taller than the Statue of Liberty! It was the biggest and most powerful rocket ever built at the time (though SpaceX's Starship megarocket has since surpassed it). NASA needed such a powerful rocket to launch astronauts to the moon. However, the first Saturn V launch didn't carry astronauts, because it was only a test flight.

During the launch, the rocket created a loud shockwave that surprised nearby observers. The ground shook so hard that it rattled buildings miles away, and all the shaking caused a huge shower of dust and debris NASA's new launch center, the Kennedy Space Center in Florida.

The mission lasted 8 hours 36 minutes. The rocket carried an uncrewed command module that splashed down in the Pacific Ocean.

Why it mattered

The launch of Apollo 4 in November 1967 was a turning point for NASA on its path to landing astronauts on the moon.

The space agency had bet the moon on its new Saturn V booster, a three-stage heavy-lift rocket designed to fly astronauts in a capsule (as well as their lander) to the moon and back. But the rocket had never been fully tested until the Apollo 4 launch.

NASA also needed a new launch site for its Apollo missions. So the agency built Launch Complex 39 at what is now called the Kennedy Space Center, a Florida spaceport that has become the home port for orbital human spaceflight in the United States. But in 1967, no rockets had ever flown from the site. Yet, everything went according to plan.

  • Amazing Apollo 4: NASA's 1st Saturn V Moon Rocket Test Flight in Photos

“It was really an expert launching all the way through from lifting off exactly on time to performance of every single stage,” rocket pioneer Wernher von Braun, director of NASA’s Marshall Space Flight Center in Huntsville, Alabama, said at the time.

The launch came as NASA was on its heels.

Just months earlier, on Jan. 27, 1967, the space agency suffered a fatal tragedy when Apollo 1 astronauts Gus Grissom, Ed White and Roger Chaffee died on the launch pad after a fire broke out inside their Apollo command module during a ground test.

“The maiden voyage of the Saturn V dramatically increased the confidence of people across the nation in the management of the largest research and development undertaking in which the western world has ever engaged,” George Mueller, NASA's then-Associate Administrator for Manned Space Flight, said at the time.

One year later, another Saturn V rocket launched the first astronauts to the moon with the Apollo 8 mission. All of the Apollo missions that followed also launched on Saturn V rockets.

Just two years after its debut, the Saturn V rocket launched the Apollo 11 astronauts to the moon for the first crewed moon landing in July 1969.

]]> <![CDATA[ Jupiter and Mars are set for a breathtaking close approach later this week: Here's how to see it ]]> Jupiter and Mars will shine side by side in a spectacular close approach in the heart of the constellation Leo on Nov. 15. Here's what you need to know.

Mars and Jupiter reach their closest apparent separation in Earth's sky at 9:04 p.m. EST on Nov. 15 (0204 GMT on Nov. 16), according to astronomy website In-The-Sky. The planets will be below the horizon for U.S. stargazers at the moment of their closest approach, but observers can catch the pair rising above the eastern horizon around midnight local time, just a few hours later.

Remember: You can discover the exact timings for the rising and setting of the planets above your local horizon using Time and Date's night sky tracker.

Jupiter will be the brightest of the pair, when it rises a little over 1 degree from the red light of Mars — roughly the width of your little finger held at arm's length against the night sky. The bright star Regulus will glow close at hand, forming the dot of the backward question mark formation of stars that represents the head of the great Lion in the constellation Leo.

Celestron StarSense Explorer LT114AZ

The Celestron StarSense Explorer LT114AZ is a great way to get a closer look at Jupiter, Mars and Saturn. Its 4.5-inch aperture and a high 1000mm focal length delivers good magnification out of the box, plus it's integrated with the StarSense smartphone app, which makes finding those planets so much easier. Check out our full review for more.

Mars and Jupiter will be close enough to share the field of view of a pair of 10x50 binoculars and will also make for a spectacular sight through the eyepiece of a telescope when viewed separately as they rise away from the horizon.

The gas giant's iconic Great Red Spot will rotate into view in the predawn hours of Nov. 16, and will be visible through a backyard telescope with an aperture of just 4 inches. Using a light green color filter will help increase the visibility of the vast storm, while an orange filter will help bring out detail in the gas giant's sweeping cloud belts.

The two planets will appear to gradually drift apart over the coming weeks and won't appear as close again for another 2.5 years in July 2029, when the two planets appear close together in the constellation Virgo.

Be sure to check out our guide to photographing the night sky, along with our picks of the best cameras and lenses for astrophotography if you're interested in following the dance of the planets for yourself.

]]> <![CDATA[ Are the James Webb Space Telescope's mysterious Little Red Dots actually tiny black holes left over from the Big Bang era? ]]> Ever since NASA's James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) started observing the early universe, it has been providing almost as many surprises as it has answers. One such surprise are the so-called Little Red Dots, cosmic objects that seemingly disappear completely before the universe is two billion years old.

New research suggests that Little Red Dots may actually be connected primordial black holes, tiny black holes born not from dying stars but rather from fluctuations in the density of matter just after the Big Bang, in the earliest moments of cosmic history. Should they exist, primordial black holes would predate stars, galactic dust particles, and elements heavier than hydrogen and helium.

Now, researchers have used JWST data to test whether one particular Little Red Dot, known as blackAbell 2744-QSO1 (QSO1), could host a primordial black hole.

"A black hole is an object born from the gravitational death of a star. Primordial black holes are a very different story," study team member Valerio De Luca, of the Department of Physics and Astronomy at Johns Hopkins University (JHU) in Maryland, said in a statement.

"They come from the physics of the early universe that predates the first stars, when the universe was expanding exponentially in time and space. So the mechanisms for creating primordial black holes are different," De Luca added.

Little Red Dots could be the smoking gun of primordial black holes

Though scientists have theorized about the existence of primordial black holes since they were first proposed by Stephen Hawking in the 1970s, no hard evidence has presented itself. One of the issues scientists have puzzled over is how to tell the difference between a primordial black hole and a "traditional" or astrophysical black hole formed from the supernova death and collapse of a massive star.

"Little Red Dots could surround astrophysical black holes, and most probably many of them do, but they could also be primordial black holes, if primordial black holes exist," De Luca said. "So the question becomes, Which ones are primordial and how can we tell?"

De Luca and colleagues turned their attention to QS01, located around 13.1 billion light-years from Earth, which is seen as it was just 700 million years after the Big Bang. What makes this Little Red Dot stand out is the fact that it is almost entirely composed of hydrogen and helium. Because these were the universe's first elements, it could be more unspoiled and primordial than other Little Red Dots.

The team modeled how a Little Red Dot like QS01 could form from a primordial black hole. That was necessary because the circumstances under which this could happen would have to be very specific.

"There are constraints on primordial black holes from cosmological observations," said team member Loris Del Grosso, also of JHU's Department of Physics and Astronomy. "There can only be so many primordial black holes in the universe, for example, and there cannot be too many of them in a given cluster."

Considering three possible scenarios, the team found that the most likely situation is a smaller primordial black hole consuming surrounding gas and energy until it grew to be the size of QSO1.

"The door was open on this theory — that Little Red Dots could be primordial black holes," Del Grosso said. "We've now cracked it open a little farther by showing some scenarios are more likely than others."

Del Grosso and crew now intend to look at the other 100 or so Little Red Dots seen by the JWST to determine how many of them could have started life as primordial black holes.

Then scientists may finally have the evidence to say these long-theorized ancient black holes actually existed.

"We don't have a clear understanding of what happens in the early universe right after the Big Bang," De Luca concluded. "If primordial black holes do exist, then something had to happen to make them in the first place, which would be a groundbreaking discovery in physics."

The team's findings were published in June in the journal Physical Review Letters.

]]> <![CDATA[ NYT bestseller ‘Robopocalypse’ is getting a TV series with Oscar winners Ron Howard and Akiva Goldsman at the helm ]]> They say all good things come to those who wait… and WAIT. Well, the wait for "Robopocalypse" fans might finally be over, as Oscar winners Ron Howard and Akiva Goldsman have announced they're working on a TV adaptation.

It does seem like an eternity since news first broke that Portland-based New York Times bestselling author Daniel H. Wilson’s "Robopocalypse" (Doubleday, 2011) was bought by Steven Spielberg’s DreamWorks SKG for a sci-fi spectacle, with Drew Goddard ("The Martian") brought in to pen the screenplay.

That was back in 2009, and since then the story of a rogue AI named Archos and a hearty band of indigenous people in America’s heartland battling to save humanity from extinction has been placed on Hollywood’s back burner. After numerous stalled starts and director Michael Bay getting involved in 2018, "Robopocalypse" was quietly powered down due to script issues, filmmaker scheduling conflicts, and the enormous budget required.

But now we have been blessed with the news, first broken by The Hollywood Reporter, that Ron Howard ("Apollo 13," "The Da Vinci Code") and Akiva Goldsman ("A Beautiful Mind," "Star Trek: Strange New Worlds") have taken up the mantle of this chilling sci-fi project to develop as a new TV series. And what timing, just as AI fever has gripped the planet with paranoia centered around our eventual robot overlords.

"'Robopocalypse' has all the scale and suspense of a major action story, but what drew me to it are the thought-provoking themes and humanity at its center," Ron Howard shared in a statement.

"Daniel created a future that feels both startling and increasingly plausible, with characters who must figure out what connects us when the technology we rely on turns against us. I am also thrilled to work with Akiva again. We have shared some incredibly meaningful creative experiences, and this feels like the right story to bring us back together."

As a PhD graduate of Carnegie Mellon University’s Robotics Institute and a future king of the techno-thriller, Wilson was the ideal writer to bring this frightening story to life, and a 2014 sequel titled "Robogenesis" was equally gripping.

The prolific, award-winning writer has since set up a multitude of other Hollywood projects spawned from his catalog of works, including "Amped," "The Clockwork Dynasty," the authorized sequel to Michael Crichton's "The Andromeda Strain," "The Andromeda Evolution," and his 2025 alien invasion novel "Hole in the Sky," still alive at Netflix.

Howard's Imagine Entertainment will partner with Akiva Goldsman's Weed Road Pictures on this episodic adaptation, with Howard attached to direct the pilot episode and Goldsman serving as series showrunner.

"Robopocalypse" marks a creative reunion for the distinguished creators, following their collaborations on "A Beautiful Mind," "Cinderella Man," "The Da Vinci Code," and "Angels & Demons." Spielberg's Amblin Entertainment is slated to executive produce the ambitious show alongside Imagine's Brian Grazer and Jeb Brody and Weed's Rachel Wizenberg and Greg Lessans.

It's too early to tell which streaming service the "Robopocalypse" TV show will be attached to yet. Hopefully the pilot episode wows one of the big names, and we can finally see the "Robopocalypse" adaptation of our dreams.

In the meantime, we'd recommend checking out the original book by Daniel H. Wilson.

]]> <![CDATA[ Starfish Space loses contact with 1st 'Otter' servicing spacecraft, ending NASA tech-demo mission ]]> Starfish Space's first Otter has died, just a month after it reached the final frontier.

The Seattle startup announced on Tuesday (Nov. 3) that its Otter 24C satellite suffered a glitch in low Earth orbit (LEO) and is not recoverable.

The anomaly killed an ambitious mission in the cradle, as Otter 24C was still in the commissioning phase.

Otter Pup 2, which launched in June 2025, has been getting closer and closer to another private spacecraft, Gilmour Space's ElaraSat. Last week, the company announced that Otter Pup 2 got within a mere 82 feet (25 meters) of its target.

"With this progress, Otter Pup 2 has officially completed Characterize, the penultimate phase of its mission. That leaves just one phase left: attempting docking, and a chance to make history," Starfish Space said in an Oct. 27 X post.

Two private satellites have docked before, but only much higher above Earth, in geostationary orbit. Such a meetup has not yet happened in LEO.

]]> <![CDATA[ NASA just launched a $1 million Moon Base Student Challenge to award cash prizes to students that solve lunar base problems ]]> CAPE CANAVERAL, Fla. — NASA has officially launched the Moon Base Student Challenge, asking students to help build humanity's future on the moon. And there's $1 million in prizes up for grabs for the winners.

To build and sustain a base on the moon, NASA will have to solve a myriad of problems. And they're looking to the next generation for help, the space agency's chief Jared Isaacman said Sunday (Nov. 8).

"We are inviting students from across the country to help solve some of the problems that stand between humanity and a permanent presence on another world," Isaacman said. "We're putting 1 million in prizes together to support the best ideas and recognize the teams behind them."

Isaacman made this announcement wearing his blue flight suit from the rocket garden at NASA's Kennedy Space Center Visitor Center amidst the agency's MAX POWER air show event. Just the day before, he flew fighter jets in that suit and even jumped out of a plane, skydiving into the event. Soon after this announcement, he was flying another fighter plane above the crowd.

The audience for this announcement was filled with students of all ages. Some young children wearing costume spacesuits squeezed as close as they could to the front of the room while teenagers considering their futures listened intently. It was clear that Isaacman's presence and words were landing with this group.

But what moon base challenges does NASA want to see these students tackle? In short, all of them.

"The moon base will allow us to conduct groundbreaking science, test new technologies, and prepare again for where we inevitably go next, which is the red planet," he said. "But before any of that can happen, we have an awful lot of problems that need to be solved."

"We need ways to generate power through the long lunar night. We need to protect our astronauts from that incredibly harsh and dangerous and demanding environment on the surface. We need to move people and equipment around on the surface and support human life three days away from Earth," Isaacman said, illustrating just a few of the big issues that present with the concept of a moon base.

How will it work?

This challenge is open to high school and post-secondary students based in the U.S. For participating students, they will form teams that will work on an idea from one of six different technical topics related to creating and running a moon base. These six topics include power systems, habitats, communications, mobility, life support and astronaut safety.

This will be what Isaacman described as a "multi-phase competition that mirrors how ideas are developed actually in the aerospace industry."

"Teams will first submit concepts, then they're going to refine them, and finalists will have the opportunity to present their solutions directly to NASA leaders and stakeholders," he further explained.

"The prize money is great for sure, but the the real opportunity is to work on problems NASA is actively trying to solve right now, so students don't need to wait to graduation to contribute to that effort," Isaacman added.

A long road ahead

Right now, NASA has a long road ahead of them before a moon base is actually built. In mid-2027, the agency is planning to launch its Artemis III mission which will see a crew of four astronauts practice rendezvous maneuvers with two different lunar landers. If all goes to plan, this will be followed by Artemis IV landing humans on the moon's surface for the first time since the final Apollo mission in 1972.

The agency is making these big steps forward to not just a crewed return to the moon, but a sustained, long-term return to the moon. However, knowing that a fully-fledged moon base is still firmly in the future, they are banking on the ingenuity, creativity and passion of

If you're a student or know a student interested in participating in this challenge, you can find more information on NASA's website here. Interested students can register until Jan. 25, 2027.

]]> <![CDATA[ Netflix announces 'Stranger Things' spin-off 'Other Worlds', and it's already teasing a trip to Area 51 (video) ]]>

So, you thought "Stranger Things" was done and dusted after all that Conformity Gate nonsense? No way! Netflix's sci-fi sensation returns in the live-action prequel series "Other Worlds: A Stranger Things Adventure."

Created by the Duffer Brothers and Kate Trefry, with the episodes set to be directed by Joe Wright ("Darkest Hour", "Black Mirror"), this new show isn't set in Hawkins or the electric '80s. No, this time around, the action takes place in Marion, Nevada, in 1955, and you know what else is located in Nevada, right? Area 51.

The teaser trailer certainly teases the possibility of a trip to the world's most paradoxically famous secret military base, showcasing a bike and radio resting outside of a fence with a sign that clearly says it's a restricted area (in any TV show or film, that's actually an invitation to see what's on the other side). Of course, the tease doesn't end there, as the thunder booms in the sky and there's a visual hint of a wormhole.

No story details about "Other Worlds: A Stranger Things Adventure" have been released to date, but there are some clues out there for all the Internet sleuths.

Trefrey wrote the Henry Creel-focused "Stranger Things: The First Shadow" play, while Matt Duffer explained to Variety how a spin-off show would tackle the rock that Henry found in the briefcase in "Stranger Things." So, yes, expect this to be a Henry-centric affair and the start of his long, hard road to hell and becoming Vecna.

What'll be interesting, though, is to see how the show ties into the history of Area 51. After all, it was on April 12, 1955, that CIA officer Richard Bissell discovered the site, while the "Other Worlds" trailer has the date of April 19th clearly marked onscreen, so the timelines align nicely here.

"Stranger Things" has never been shy of tying itself to real-world science and historical events, so it'll be fascinating to see how the show explores Area 51 as a concept and the secrets everybody believes are hidden there.

Was it really a site to test highly advanced weapons and aircraft, or was E.T.'s cousin held hostage there until he revealed Colonel Sanders' 11 herbs and spices? Who knows, with all this renewed excitement around this mysterious military facility, we might get another "Storm Area 51" event to enjoy and laugh at all over again.

Regardless, more "Stranger Things" is welcome news, and since it's presumably about one of the show's best characters, Henry Creel, it only adds another layer to his already intriguing lore. If we can't have an origin story about Hopper's incredible and envious moustache, this is the next best thing.

"Other Worlds: A Stranger Things Adventure" arrives on Netflix in 2028.

]]> <![CDATA[ NASA needs more astronauts for moon missions and beyond. You can apply now, but only until Dec. 3 ]]> If NASA ever hopes to build a permanent moon base for astronauts, let alone aim for Mars, the U.S. space agency is going to need a whole lot of space travelers. And now, you have a chance to be one of them.

NASA on Saturday (Nov. 7) put out the call for a new class of astronaut candidates who think they have the "right stuff" to fly, live and work in space. Those astronaut hopefuls have until Dec. 3 to apply (the application website is here), with NASA planning to make its final selections in late 2027.

"This is an extraordinary time to join NASA's astronaut corps," the space agency's chief, Jared Isaacman, said in an announcement, which was made during NASA's "Max Power" air show at Kennedy Space Center (KSC) in Florida. "The people we select could walk on the moon, live and work at the Moon Base, and help pioneer the systems and operations that will ultimately carry crews to Mars."

It's been two years since NASA last sought applications for astronauts. In 2024, more than 8,000 people applied, though only 10 — five men and five women — made the cut. They're in the middle of a two-year training program right now.

This new 2027 astronaut group will be the 25th astronaut class in NASA history. Its announcement comes the same year that NASA returned astronauts to the moon for the first time since the Apollo era with the Artemis II moon flyby. Four more astronauts will test Artemis moon landers in Earth orbit on the Artemis III mission in 2027.

NASA currently has 32 active astronauts in its spaceflying corps. The agency has recruited 370 people to fly in space since 1959, when the first seven Mercury astronauts were selected and unveiled to the world.

"There is a lot to be done in order to get all of these new vehicles and the new suits and everything as we continue to work towards the moon, build a base there, stay permanently, and then eventually onto Mars," NASA astronaut Nichole Stilwell, class of 2021, told Space.com in an interview at KSC during the Max Power event. "And so we just don't have enough people, and we're looking for more."

If you're interested in applying to be a NASA astronaut, you should take a look at the requirements first.

NASA's core guidelines require applicants to be U.S. citizens and have a master's degree in a STEM field like "engineering, biological science, physical science, or computer science from an accredited institution," the space agency said in a statement. You'll also need at least three years of experience in your related field.

Don't have a master's degree? Here's three other ways NASA might consider your application, according to the agency's advisory:

  • "Completion of at least two years of work toward a doctoral program in an appropriate technical field of engineering, biological science, physical science, computer science, or mathematics. 
  • "Completion of a Doctor of Medicine, Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine, Physician Assistant, Doctor of Nursing Practice, Family Nurse Practitioner, or a related medical degree. 
  • "Completion of, or current enrollment in, a nationally recognized Test Pilot School program, provided the program is completed by July 2027. If Test Pilot School is the only advanced technical degree, then completion of a bachelor’s degree in a STEM field, including engineering, biological science, physical science, or computer science is required."

If you're a medical doctor and are considering applying to be an astronaut, your residency training can be counted toward your professional experience, but only if it is completed by July 2027, NASA said.

If you want to be a pilot astronaut for NASA, you'll need some serious flight hours under your belt. Here's a rundown of some ways to meet that requirement:

  • 750 hours flying as pilot in command of high-performance jet aircraft.
  • 1,000 total flight hours in a rotary-wing aircraft, with 300 hours as pilot in command.
  • 1,500 total flight hours in other fixed-wing aircraft, with 750 hours as pilot in command.

"For those who apply, becoming a NASA astronaut is more than a career opportunity,” said NASA chief astronaut Scott Tingle, who also chairs the Astronaut Selection Board at the agency's Johnson Space Center (JSC) in Houston. "It is a chance to join a legacy of explorers who have pushed the boundaries of discovery and play a role in the missions that will shape humanity’s future in space."

Once NASA selects its 2027 astronaut class, the new recruits can expect to begin a two-year training program based out of JSC, which is home to the agency's astronaut corp and Mission Control.

“The window is open. The mission is waiting.," NASA Deputy Administrator Matt Anderson said in a statement. "And the only thing missing from the greatest adventure humanity has ever embarked upon is you."

Space.com Content Manager Chelsea Gohd contributed to this report from NASA's Max Power event at the Kennedy Space Center in Cape Canaveral, Florida.

 <description>Zimní údržbu silnic a chodníků budou letos v ulicích České Lípy poprvé zajišťovat městské technické služby. Vznikly v roce 2024, aby mohly postupně přebírat práce namísto soukromých firem. Letos už měly na starost letní údržbu. Nyní pomůžou Technické služby s přípravou na sníh, který brzy začne padat. Komunikace budou sypat solí i speciálním ekologickým posypem. </description>
 <enclosure url="https://www.irozhlas.cz/sites/default/files/styles/zpravy_maly_nahled/public/uploader/zuj_9964_231202-095704_zuj.jpg?itok=W55qqV3j" type="image/jpeg" />

</item>

 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-domov/bohumin-pred-stoletou-vodou-chrani-nova-hraz-plna-nepropustneho-jilu-mesto_2611101215_jho</link>
 <description>Bohumín má novou protipovodňovou ochranu před stoletou vodou. Město na soutoku Odry a Olše v minulosti opakovaně zasáhly ničivé povodně, při té poslední v roce 2024 dosáhly škody na jeho území téměř 1,5 miliardy korun. Povodí Odry nyní dokončilo poslední část ochranných hrází v městské části Pudlov.</description>

</item>
<item>
 <title>Popáté v řadě se náchodským starostou stal Jan Birke. Nové Město nad Metují opět povede Slavík z ODS</title>
 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-domov/popate-v-rade-se-nachodskym-starostou-stal-jan-birke-nove-mesto-nad-metuji-opet_2611101201_jho</link>
 <description>Starostou Náchoda je znovu Jan Birke, který město bez přestávky vede už od roku 2010. Na ustavujícím zastupitelstvu pro něj hlasovalo 20 z celkových 27 zastupitelů. Ve městě bude vládnout jeho koalice uskupení Jan Birke pro Náchod spolu s Žijeme Náchodem a Patrioty. Vedení si v pondělí odhlasovali také jinde na Náchodsku. Starostou Nového Města nad Metují se opět stal Milan Slavík (ODS), Meziměstí povede Martin Vlček (R.O.Z.U.M. pro Meziměstí).</description>

<item>
 <title>Sněmovní výbor zahájil řízení vůči Ševčíkovi kvůli výroku o menopauze, poslanec mluví o nafouknuté kauze</title>
 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-domov/sevcik-snemovni-vybor-rizeni_2611101154_elev</link>
 <description>Sněmovní mandátový a imunitní výbor v úterý zahájil disciplinární řízení vůči poslanci za SPD Miroslavu Ševčíkovi. Ševčík čelí podnětu předsedkyně poslaneckého klubu STAN Michaely Šebelové kvůli výrokům o menopauze, kterých se dopustil na plénu. Šebelová chce, aby výbor Ševčíkovi uložil veřejnou omluvu na sněmovním plénu.</description>
 <enclosure url="https://www.irozhlas.cz/sites/default/files/styles/zpravy_maly_nahled/public/uploader/img_9290_230315-104708_afo.jpg?itok=u846VXfj" type="image/jpeg" />

</item>
<item>
 <title>Salmonelóza v Újezdu nad Lesy byla z prošlých vajec, potvrdili hygienici. V jídelně odhalili více pochybení</title>
 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-domov/salmoneloza-v-ujezde-nad-lesy-byla-z-proslych-vajec-potvrdili-hygienici-v_2611101147_jho</link>
 <description>Zdrojem epidemie salmonelózy v pražském Újezdu nad Lesy byl pokrm z prošlých vajec, který tam v září podávala školní kuchyně Masarykovy základní školy. Výsledek vyšetřování ve školní jídelně sdělila na dotaz mluvčí pražské hygienické stanice (HSHMP) Petra Batók. Hygienici podle ní v kuchyni odhalili více pochybení. O sankci teprve rozhodnou.</description>
 <enclosure url="https://www.irozhlas.cz/sites/default/files/styles/zpravy_maly_nahled/public/uploader/profimedia-113946221_261005-135233_ntu.jpg?itok=qrwQv1Sp" type="image/jpeg" />

</item>

 <title>Většina měst Zlínského kraje má zvolené vedení. Zasedání se konala ve Vsetíně nebo v Uherském Brodě</title>
 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-domov/vetsina-mest-zlinskeho-kraje-ma-zvolene-vedeni-zasedani-se-konala-ve-vsetine_2611101142_aru</link>
 <description>Vsetín, Rožnov pod Radhoštěm, Uherský Brod nebo Slavičín mají nově zvoleného starostu. O tom, kdo města povede v následujících čtyřech letech, rozhodli pondělí v podvečer zastupitelé na ustavujících zasedáních.</description>
 <enclosure url="https://www.irozhlas.cz/sites/default/files/styles/zpravy_maly_nahled/public/images/ac8694173aeba90bb44edecc8f646495.jpg?itok=nsX75jIb" type="image/jpeg" />

</item>
<item>
 <title>Ve středu se při dešti bude tvořit ledovka. Hrozí na jihu a západě Čech, nejvíc v Karlovarském kraji</title>
 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-domov/ve-stredu-se-pri-desti-bude-tvorit-ledovka-hrozi-na-jihu-a-zapade-cech-nejvic-v_2611101135_aru</link>
 <description>Ve středu ráno se bude na jihu a západě Čech a na jihozápadě Moravy při dešti tvořit ledovka, místy i silná. Nejvíc budou silnice a chodníky klouzat v Karlovarském kraji a v části Plzeňského a Ústeckého kraje, varoval v úterní výstraze Český hydrometeorologický ústav (ČHMÚ). V průběhu dopoledne bude ledovka postupně odtávat.</description>
 <enclosure url="https://www.irozhlas.cz/sites/default/files/styles/zpravy_maly_nahled/public/uploader/profimedia-074596201_221221-140013_pj.jpg?itok=p95PfIHI" type="image/jpeg" />

</item>

   <title>Nejen mrtvá rodina, byt střelce z Polska ukrýval další hrůzy. Muž studoval vrahy</title>
   <link>https://www.denik.cz/evropa/polsko-strelec-z-krakova-co-nasla-policie-v-byte-utocnik-se-zajimal-o-vraha-breivika/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=feed-vse&utm_campaign=ceskolipsky.denik.cz&utm_content=evropa</link>
   <description>V bytě rodiny střelce z Krakova nezahynuli jen jeho rodiče a sestra. Podle polských médií útočník zastřelil také dvě kočky. Vrah tam vypálil nejméně osmkrát, podle polských médií navíc použil tlumič. Muž, který následně v centru Krakova zabil šest lidí a další zranil, se podle polského ministra spravedlnosti Waldemara Żureka zajímal o norského teroristu Anderse Breivika.</description>

   <description>Změna počasí v Česku v některých regionech prověří chodce, silničáře i řidiče.   <item>
   <title>Jak zazimovat chatu a odradit zloděje či kuny? Chyby mohou majitele přijít draho</title>
   <link>https://www.denik.cz/cesko/jak-zabezpecit-chalupu-na-zimu-zlodeji-kuny/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=feed-vse&utm_campaign=ceskolipsky.denik.cz&utm_content=cesko</link>
   <description>Zloději, mráz a nepřízeň počasí, myši a kuny i špatně sepsaná či zastaralá smlouva na pojištění chaty či chalupy. To vše jsou největší hrozby pro jejich majitele v zimním období, kdy svá letní sídla nechávají bez dozoru. Jak je tedy správně zazimovat a co je třeba si v této souvislosti pohlídat? Deník.cz přináší odpovědi na nejdůležitější související otázky.</description>
   <pubDate>Tue, 10 Nov 2026 05:30:00 +0100</pubDate>
   <guid>https://www.denik.cz/cesko/jak-zabezpecit-chalupu-na-zimu-zlodeji-kuny/</guid>
   <category>Česko</category>
   <enclosure url="https://ceskolipsky.denik.cz/images/api/image/1366x768/497/49726046-4cdb-4ce9-a61e-7e56843674c7.jpeg" length="0" type="image/jpeg"/>
   <media:content url="https://ceskolipsky.denik.cz/images/api/image/1366x768/497/49726046-4cdb-4ce9-a61e-7e56843674c7.jpeg" medium="image" height="768" width="1366">
    <media:description>Zazimování chalupy je náročná akce. Každé opomenutí může mít s příchodem jara ničivé důsledky.</media:description>
    <media:credit>Shutterstock</media:credit>
   </media:content>
  </item>
  <item>
   <title>Česko začalo trápit náledí. Špatné gumy teď mohou zničit i rodinný rozpočet</title>
   <link>https://www.denik.cz/doprava/cesko-mrazy-snih-jake-pneumatiky-pouzivat-kdy-hrozi-pokuta/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=feed-vse&utm_campaign=ceskolipsky.denik.cz&utm_content=doprava</link>
   <description>Od 1. listopadu platí na českých silnicích povinnost používat zimní pneumatiky. Nejde však o absolutní nařízení za každého počasí – pokud na vozovce neleží sníh či námraza a jejich výskyt nelze očekávat, je možné vyjet i na letních. V opačném případě však auto musí mít zimní obutí, jinak hrozí tisícové pokuty. Největší riziko ale číhá jinde: při zavinění vážné nehody může pojišťovna vyplacené škody vymáhat po viníkovi. Částky za zranění jdou přitom běžně do milionů korun.</description>
   <pubDate>Tue, 10 Nov 2026 04:00:00 +0100</pubDate>
   <guid>https://www.denik.cz/doprava/cesko-mrazy-snih-jake-pneumatiky-pouzivat-kdy-hrozi-pokuta/</guid>
   <category>Doprava</category>
   <enclosure url="https://ceskolipsky.denik.cz/images/api/image/1366x768/8e1/8e10f911-36f6-40a5-ade7-e0e6776c5d85.jpeg" length="0" type="image/jpeg"/>
   <media:content url="https://ceskolipsky.denik.cz/images/api/image/1366x768/8e1/8e10f911-36f6-40a5-ade7-e0e6776c5d85.jpeg" medium="image" height="768" width="1366">
    <media:description>Dopravní experti každoročně radí nečekat na to, až se takzvaně zima zeptá a na silnici bude sníh nebo ledovka, ale vyměnit letní pneumatiky za zimní včas.</media:description>
    <media:credit>Karel Pech</media:credit>
   </media:content>

    <item>
      <title>ScreenVoice slaví pět let. Platforma přináší data a trendy z televizního trhu</title>
      <link>https://www.idnes.cz/zpravy/mediahub/screenvoice-pet-let-vyroci-aktv.A261110_120342_mediahub_jpl#utm_source=rss&utm_medium=feed&utm_campaign=zpravodaj&utm_content=main</link>
      <description>Platforma ScreenVoice, kterou Asociace komerčních televizí (AKTV) spustila v roce 2021, přináší už pět let českému mediálnímu trhu aktuální informace, inspiraci, výzkumy i původní obsah zaměřený na televizi, total video a televizní reklamu. Platforma se etablovala jako oborový zdroj, který propojuje aktuální dění na českém i zahraničním trhu s původním autorským obsahem, výzkumy a daty.</description>

    <item>
      <title>Frustrované Rusko po neúspěších na frontě zesiluje údery na civilní cíle</title>
      <link>https://www.idnes.cz/zpravy/nato/rusko-ukrajina-valka-drony-ztraty-rakety.A261110_130446_zpr_nato_inc#utm_source=rss&utm_medium=feed&utm_campaign=zpravodaj&utm_content=main</link>
      <description>Přibývající barbarské útoky na ukrajinské školy či nemocnice jsou podle expertů důsledkem rostoucí frustrace Ruska z neúspěchů na frontě. A také rekordních ztrát, které jen v říjnu překonaly hranici 54 tisíc zabitých a vážně zraněných ruských vojáků. Ukrajina naopak naplno obnovila dálkové údery na ruskou kritickou palivovou infrastrukturu s cílem snížit schopnost okupantů udržovat vojenskou logistiku. </description>

    <item>
      <title>V Abú Zabí začaly rozhovory o Ukrajině. Řeší se i bezpečnostní rámec pro Evropu</title>
      <link>https://www.idnes.cz/zpravy/zahranicni/usa-rusko-a-ukrajina-zahaji-jednani-o-konci-valky-ucast-evropy-je-nejasna.A261110_074245_zahranicni_pluh#utm_source=rss&utm_medium=feed&utm_campaign=zpravodaj&utm_content=main</link>
      <description>Ve Spojených arabských emirátech v úterý začaly dvoudenní americko-rusko-ukrajinská jednání o ukončení války. Ukrajinský vyjednavač a šéf civilní rozvědky Rustem Umerov informoval o úvodní schůzce se zástupci Británie, Francie, Německa, Itálie, NATO a Evropské komise. Hlavní část rozhovorů v metropoli je třístranná, tedy mezi Ukrajinci a Rusy za zprostředkování Američanů. Schůzky ukrajinských a amerických představitelů se zástupci evropských zemí a Severoatlantické aliance označila Moskva v pondělí za koordinační a uvedla, že Evropané u hlavního jednacího stolu nebudou.</description>
      <pubDate>Tue, 10 Nov 2026 12:37:00 GMT</pubDate>
      <category domain="https://www.idnes.cz/zpravy/zahranicni">Zprávy - Zahraničí</category>

      <guid isPermaLink="false">A261110_074245_zahranicni_pluh</guid>
      <media:content url="https://1gr.cz/fotky/idnes/26/112/cl6/PLU54bbb394c9_32CRISIS_TALKS_ABU_DHABI.JPG" type="image/jpeg" />
      <media:description>Jared Kushner, ministr zahraničních věcí Spojených arabských emirátů šejk Abdulláh bin Zájid Ál Nahján, zvláštní vyslanec Spojených států Steve Witkoff a generál amerického letectva Alexus Grynkewich. (10. listopadu 2026)</media:description>

<link>https://www.lupa.cz/aktuality/kanadsky-globalni-hrac-dokoncil-akvizici-ceskeho-startupu-aisle-praha-ma-ve-firme-hrat-dulezitou-roli/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=text&utm_campaign=rss</link>
<description>Kanadská AI společnost Cohere dokončila akvizici pražského kyberbezpečnostního startupu Aisle, za nímž stojí Ondřej Vlček, Stanislav Fort a Jaya Baloo. Vlček to oznámil na LinkedInu. Firmy dříve uzavřenou dohodu o koupi představily v polovině října. Vzniká nová divize Cohere Cyber, kterou povede právě Vlček jako senior viceprezident. &#8222;Uzavíráme jednu kapitolu a otevíráme dal&#353;í, s je&#353;tě vět&#353;ími ambicemi a mnohem &#353;ir&#353;ími možnostmi,&#8220; věří Vlček.</description>

Další díl seriálu Jak na veřejné IT zakázky, který Lupa připravuje ve spolupráci s Asociací softwarových agentur (ASWA), nabízí šest konkrétních doporučení pro přípravu a hodnocení veřejných zakázek na dodávku softwarových řešení.</description>

<title>ČNB otestovala technologii známou z kryptoměn. Chtěla by rychleji obchodovat s dluhopisy</title>
<link>https://www.lupa.cz/aktuality/cnb-otestovala-technologii-znamou-z-kryptomen-chtela-by-rychleji-obchodovat-s-dluhopisy/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=text&utm_campaign=rss</link>
<description>Česká národní banka (ČNB) otestovala obchodování s vlastními dluhopisy prostřednictvím technologie, která je spojená předev&#353;ím s bitcoinem a dal&#353;ími kryptoměnami. Využila systém distribuovaného registru (DLT) k vydání a převodům běžných korunových dluhopisů v digitální podobě, kde má dluhopis podobu digitálního tokenu. Podle guvernéra ČNB Ale&#353;e Michla je DLT &#8222;možnou platformou budoucnosti&#8220;.</description>

 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-svet/usa-rusko-vztahy-midterms_2611100620_ula</link>
 <description>Rusko v reakci na výsledky midterms a prohru republikánů zdůrazňuje, že americký prezident Donald Trump zůstává u moci, a zároveň Kreml odmítá, že by změna v uspořádání amerického Kongresu mohla jakýmkoli způsobem ovlivnit jeho politiku vůči Ukrajině. Té naopak podle Zelenského svitla naděje, že by nyní Spojené státy mohly pomoc Kyjevu zesílit. Odborníci nicméně vesměs upozorňují, že nadšení je třeba v tomto případě trochu mírnit.</description>

 <description>Ve Spojených arabských emirátech začala v úterý 10. listopadu dvoudenní americko-rusko-ukrajinská jednání o ukončení války, kterou proti Ukrajině Moskva rozpoutala v roce 2022. Ukrajinský vyjednavač a šéf civilní rozvědky Rustem Umerov na síti Telegram informoval o úvodní schůzce se zástupci Británie, Francie, Německa, Itálie, NATO a Evropské komise. Hlavní část rozhovorů je třístranná, tedy mezi Ukrajinci a Rusy za zprostředkování Američanů.</description>

 <description>Američtí republikáni prezidenta Donalda Trumpa analyzují příčiny drtivé porážky ve volbách. „Ukrajinská otázka tam hrála zcela minimální roli. Američané skutečně volili spíše svými peněženkami než čímkoliv jiným,“ myslí si Dušan Neumann, publicista žijící v USA. „Pro střed Ameriky to je zásadní téma a na voliče vliv mělo,“ tvrdí o postoji k Rusku v pořadu Pro a proti bývalý konzul v Chicagu a exvelvyslanec v Kanadě Bořek Lizec.</description>

 <description>Davy lidí přišly v pondělí večer na historické náměstí Rynek Glówny v Krakově uctít památku obětí sobotní střelby. Na pochodu ticha se podle polských médií v sychravém počasí sešli obyvatelé a návštěvníci druhého největšího polského města i vrcholní představitelé země.</description>

<item>
 <title>Republikánský kongresman chce Hegsethův impeachment. Trump se svého ‚ministra války‘ zastal</title>
 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-svet/republikansky-kongresman-chce-hegsethuv-impeachment-trump-se-sveho-ministra_2611092307_jos</link>
 <description>Republikánský kongresman Thomas Massie v pondělí ve Sněmovně reprezentantů představil návrh na impeachment neboli ústavní žalobu na ministra obrany Petea Hegsetha, informuje agentura AP. Podle ní by Sněmovna mohla o věci hlasovat v polovině týdne. Americký prezident Donald Trump podle agentury Reuters vzápětí Hegsetha hájil a tvrdil, že ministr vyhrál dvě války.</description>

</item>
<item>
 <title>Evropa bude prvním klimaticky neutrálním kontinentem, věří Miko. Začíná COP31 v Antalyi</title>
 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-svet/evropa-bude-prvnim-klimaticky-neutralnim-kontinentem-veri-miko-zacina-cop31-v_2611092232_lbl</link>
 <description>Začala klimatická konference COP31, jež se koná v turecké Antalyi. Má se na ní diskutovat o boji proti globálnímu oteplování a dalších tématech. „Věřím, že Evropa bude prvním velkým územním celkem, který bude klimaticky neutrální,“ říká pro Radiožurnál přírodovědec a exministr životního prostředí Ladislav Miko. „Když se podíváte na země, které za poslední období dokázaly snížit emise, byť z obrovského základu, je to paradoxně Čína a USA,“ dodává.</description>

Vzniká nová divize Cohere Cyber, kterou povede právě Vlček jako senior viceprezident. &#8222;Uzavíráme jednu kapitolu a otevíráme dal&#353;í, s je&#353;tě vět&#353;ími ambicemi a mnohem &#353;ir&#353;ími možnostmi,&#8220; věří Vlček.</description>

<description>Česká národní banka (ČNB) otestovala obchodování s vlastními dluhopisy prostřednictvím technologie, která je spojená předev&#353;ím s bitcoinem a dal&#353;ími kryptoměnami. Využila systém distribuovaného registru (DLT) k vydání a převodům běžných korunových dluhopisů v digitální podobě, kde má dluhopis podobu digitálního tokenu. Podle guvernéra ČNB Ale&#353;e Michla je DLT &#8222;možnou platformou budoucnosti&#8220;.</description>

</item>

<description>Televize Nova a slovenská Markíza v roce 2027 uvedou společnou krasobruslařskou soutěž Hvězdy na ledě. Známé osobnosti v ní vytvoří dvojice s profesionálními krasobruslaři. Jejich sestavy budou obě stanice vysílat živě z pražských Letňan.</description>

<rss version="2.0" xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><channel><title>Liberecká Drbna</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz</link><description>Liberecká Drbna</description><language>cs</language><item><title>Tragický požár v Doksech: Obětí byli bezdomovci, zemřeli na otravu dýmem</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/krimi/905412-tragicky-pozar-v-doksech-obeti-byli-bezdomovci-zemreli-na-otravu-dymem.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/krimi/905412-tragicky-pozar-v-doksech-obeti-byli-bezdomovci-zemreli-na-otravu-dymem.html</guid><pubDate>Tue, 10 Nov 2026 13:17:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>Martina Petrášková</dc:creator><category>Krimi</category><description>Při víkendovém požáru opuštěného zemědělského objektu v Doksech zemřeli muž a žena, kteří objekt využívali k přespávání. Podle výsledků soudní pitvy podlehli otravě oxidem uhelnatým, expertiza vyloučila cizí zavinění. Příčinu vzniku požáru i celkovou výši škody vyšetřovatelé nadále objasňují.</description></item><item><title>Starostou Semil se stal poslanec Pražák, hlasovali pro něj všichni zastupitelé</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/politika/905374-starostou-semil-se-stal-poslanec-prazak-hlasovali-pro-nej-vsichni.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/politika/905374-starostou-semil-se-stal-poslanec-prazak-hlasovali-pro-nej-vsichni.html</guid><pubDate>Tue, 10 Nov 2026 12:12:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>ČTK</dc:creator><category>Politika</category><description>Starostou Semil se stal poslanec David Pražák. V tajné volbě dostal hlasy všech zastupitelů. Do zastupitelstva města byl sice Pražák zvolen za ANO, po komunálních volbách ale z hnutí odešel. Působit bude jako nezařazený, stejně jako všech pět ostatních zastupitelů zvolených na kandidátce ANO.</description></item><item><title>V jablonecké večerce zakázali prodej teplých jídel. Vadila chybějící teplá voda</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/905391-v-jablonecke-vecerce-zakazali-prodej-teplych-jidel-vadila-chybejici-tepla-voda.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/905391-v-jablonecke-vecerce-zakazali-prodej-teplych-jidel-vadila-chybejici-tepla-voda.html</guid><pubDate>Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:00:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>Martina Petrášková</dc:creator><category>Společnost</category><description>Při běžné kontrole v Jablonci nad Nisou narazili inspektoři Státní zemědělské a potravinářské inspekce (SZPI) na hygienické nedostatky v provozovně PHÚ BIÉN NGUYEN "POTRAVINY" v Pivovarské ulici. Dne 9. listopadu 2026 proto rozhodli o dočasném uzavření úseku teplé kuchyně a nebaleného pečiva v ní.</description></item><item><title>První sníh v Libereckém kraji. Nasněžilo na Ještědu i v Jizerkách</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/905384-prvni-snih-v-libereckem-kraji-nasnezilo-na-jestedu-i-v-jizerkach.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/905384-prvni-snih-v-libereckem-kraji-nasnezilo-na-jestedu-i-v-jizerkach.html</guid><pubDate>Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:43:48 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>Luboš Vrabec</dc:creator><category>Společnost</category><description>Ranní srážky přinesly v nížinách déšť, ve vyšších polohách ale sněžilo. V Libereckém kraji tak napadl první sníh na Ještědu i v Jizerských horách.</description></item><item><title>Zranění horolezce na Ořešníku. Padal z deseti metrů</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/905378-zraneni-horolezce-na-oresniku-padal-z-deseti-metru.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/905378-zraneni-horolezce-na-oresniku-padal-z-deseti-metru.html</guid><pubDate>Tue, 10 Nov 2026 08:45:21 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>Luboš Vrabec</dc:creator><category>Společnost</category><description>Příslušníci horské služby zasahovali v Jizerských horách. Na Ořešníku spadl horolezec, který se zranil. Zásah trval zhruba hodinu a půl.</description></item><item><title>Vlaky v kraji nabírají zpoždění. Liberecký kraj žádá od Poláků rychlé řešení</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/doprava/905355-vlaky-v-kraji-dal-nabiraji-zpozdeni-liberecky-kraj-zada-od-polaku-rychle-reseni.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/doprava/905355-vlaky-v-kraji-dal-nabiraji-zpozdeni-liberecky-kraj-zada-od-polaku-rychle-reseni.html</guid><pubDate>Tue, 10 Nov 2026 06:30:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>Martina Petrášková</dc:creator><category>Doprava</category><description>Opakované krádeže a poškozování železničních kabelů komplikují cestování z Liberce do německé Žitavy přes Hrádek nad Nisou. Vlaky nabírají zpoždění a cestující nestíhají navazující spoje. Liberecký kraj proto vyzval polské velvyslanectví i železničáře k urychlení oprav a opatřením proti krádežím.</description></item><item><title>Výsledek voleb v Liberci platí. Soud zamítl stížnost, zastupitelé usednou 19. listopadu</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/politika/905350-soud-zamitl-navrh-na-neplatnost-hlasovani-ve-volbach-v-liberci.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/politika/905350-soud-zamitl-navrh-na-neplatnost-hlasovani-ve-volbach-v-liberci.html</guid><pubDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 18:55:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>ČTK</dc:creator><category>Politika</category><description>Soud v pondělí 9. listopadu zamítl návrh na neplatnost hlasování v komunálních volbách v Liberci. Návrh končícího náměstka primátora Adama Lenerta (ANO) byl založen jen na statistických odchylkách, soud ho odmítl jako nedůvodný, vyplývá z rozhodnutí na úřední desce pobočky krajského soudu v Liberci.</description></item><item><title>Liberecké gymnastky září. Z MČR vezou stříbro, doma vybojovaly dvě zlata</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/ostatni-sporty/905310-liberecke-gymnastky-zari-z-mcr-vezou-stribro-doma-vybojovaly-dve-zlata.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/ostatni-sporty/905310-liberecke-gymnastky-zari-z-mcr-vezou-stribro-doma-vybojovaly-dve-zlata.html</guid><pubDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 18:00:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>Martina Petrášková</dc:creator><category>Ostatní sporty</category><description>Podzimní závodní sezona je v plném proudu a gymnastky z oddílu Sportovní gymnastika Liberec mají za sebou další úspěšná vystoupení. Na mistrovství České republiky v Lounech získaly stříbrnou medaili, na domácím Ještědském poháru přidaly dvě vítězství. A další důležité závody je čekají.</description></item><item><title>Pohyb s dětmi v městském provozu? Dopravní podnik pozval preventisty z celého Česka</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/doprava/905075-pohyb-s-detmi-v-mestskem-provozu-dopravni-podnik-pozval-preventisty-z-celeho-ceska.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/doprava/905075-pohyb-s-detmi-v-mestskem-provozu-dopravni-podnik-pozval-preventisty-z-celeho-ceska.html</guid><pubDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 16:45:00 +0100</pubDate><category>Doprava</category><description>Na šest desítek policejních preventistů přišlo do libereckého dopravního podniku. Důvod? Aby si na vlastní kůži vyzkoušeli a osahali, jak se pohybovat v blízkosti zastávek MHD, autobusů a tramvají. Své zkušenosti pak předají ve školách a školkách.</description></item><item><title>Speciální tričko pro řidiče z Liberce má vylepšenou verzi</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/905275-specialni-tricko-pro-ridice-z-liberce-ma-vylepsenou-verzi.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/905275-specialni-tricko-pro-ridice-z-liberce-ma-vylepsenou-verzi.html</guid><pubDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 15:00:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>Luboš Vrabec</dc:creator><category>Společnost</category><description>Vědci z liberecké univerzity loni představili tričko se senzory, které dokáže podle dechu řidičky nebo řidiče rozpoznat nastupující nebezpečnou únavu dříve, než hrozí mikrospánek. Vývoj ale pokračoval a nyní proběhlo testování druhé verze trika.</description></item></channel></rss>

 <description><p class="rtejustify">

výběžek.eu https://www.vybezek.eu dobrý den ze šluknovského výběžku, konce světa - šluknovský výběžek Tue, 10 Nov 2026 08:47:57 +0000 cs hourly 1 https://wordpress.org/?v=7.1.4 https://www.vybezek.eu/wp-uploads/2018/09/cropped-favicon-vybezek-32x32.png výběžek.eu https://www.vybezek.eu 32 32 Vítr z hor – Tobias Piero Dohm: RAUM – ZEIT https://www.vybezek.eu/296639-vitr-z-hor-tobias-piero-dohm-raum-zeit/ Tue, 10 Nov 2026 08:47:57 +0000 https://www.vybezek.eu/?p=296639 V pondělí 9. listopadu 2026 byl zahájen letošní ročník divadelního festivalu Vítr z hor, jako první se představil performer Tobias Piero Dohm v představení RAUM – ZEIT.

Z anotací – Festival Vítr z hor se i letos připojuje k mezinárodní akci La Nuit du Cirque, a přináší do Šluknovského výběžku cirkusový vír fantazie, odvahy a hravosti. A co vás čeká?

Kromě tří dnů Cirkusových nocí 13. – 15. 11. i dvě další novocirkusová představení 9. a 12. listopadu! Nenechte si je ujít! V pondělí 9. 11. 2026 Tobias Piero Dohm (@pieroodo): Raum Zeit. Vizuálně působivá inscenace, v níž se pohybem, objekty a proměnlivým prostorem posouvají hranice mezi tělem, prostředím a časem.

Tma, kouř, koule. Koule skoro všude. A písek…

]]> Festival rostlin v České Kamenici https://www.vybezek.eu/296611-festival-rostlin-v-ceske-kamenici/ Sat, 07 Nov 2026 15:26:06 +0000 https://www.vybezek.eu/?p=296611 V sobotu 7. a neděli 8. listopadu 2026 se ve sportovní hale v České Kamenici koná Festival rostlin.

Akce, která pokud vím, tu dosud neměla obdoby. Celá hala plná několika řad regálů a na nich kytky, spousty kytek. Mnohdy takových, jaké jste ještě nejspíš ani neviděli… A davy, odnášející si mnohdy nejednu plnou tašku. Neuvěřitelný výběr. Plus nějaké doplňky.

Pro mne zjištění, že jsem uvázl v minulosti a jsem mimo nejen v náhledu na ceny v restauracích, ale zaspal jsem i cenový vývoj u pokojovek. Vlastně hrůza, jak velké jmění mi za pár let doma různě uschlo…

]]> Parní vlak na trase Drážďany – Moldava a zpět 07. 11. 2026 https://www.vybezek.eu/296569-parni-vlak-na-trase-drazdany-moldava-a-zpet-07-11-2026/ Sat, 07 Nov 2026 13:57:39 +0000 https://www.vybezek.eu/?p=296569 V sobotu 7. listopadu 2026 za hojného zájmu přihlížejících dětí, dospělých i šotoušů zastavila na vlakovém nádraží v Rumburku zase jednou souprava tažená parní lokomotivou (35 1097).

Žst. Rumburk:

Moldavská dráha / Teplický Semmering / „Most – Freiberg“ na FB:

V SOBOTU 7. LISTOPADU VYRAZÍ Z DRÁŽĎAN PARNÍ VLAK NA MOLDAVU!

Železniční muzeum Dresden-Altstadt a spolek Flügelradtouristik pořádají mimořádnou jízdu historického vlaku s oddílovými osobními vozy a jídelním vozem.

Z Drážďan vyrazí v 6:30 s německou parní lokomotivou 35 1097 přes Rumburk a Děčín do Mostu. Zde převezme vlak česká parní lokomotiva 433.001 „Skaličák“, které bude na horské trati pomáhat dieselová lokomotiva.

Most 12:00 – Osek město 12:32 – Dubí 13:22 – Moldava 14:09. Zpět z Moldavy vlak odjede v 15:20 přes Dubí, Louku u Litvínova a Teplice do Drážďan. Část historické soupravy zamíří také do Žatce, města chmele a piva.

Souprava na nádraží doplnila vodu (výpomoc poskytly dva vozy JSDH Brtníky), a posádka provedla na mašině nutný servis (trochu mne zaskočily dva pytle písku, ale má to logické vysvětlení).

Na FB Děčínsko video a info:

Parní vlak v čele s německou lokomotivou 35 1097-1 (vyrobenou v roce 1959 a známou také pod přezdívkou Rübezahl) projel v sobotu dopoledne těsně před desátou hodinou po železničním mostě mezi Děčínem východ a hlavním nádražím. Pohled na tuto historickou soupravu z nové lávky pro pěší a cyklisty.

Po „loňské“ premiéře opakování nové disciplíny.





Prozatímní výsledky škol:


Ze sociálních sítí:

TOS VDF:

Třetí místo ve futsale vybojovala naše školní reprezentace v dalším dílu seriálu Sportovních her mládeže.

Ve skupině jsme nejprve porazili pozdějšího vítěze, rumburskou obchodku 2:1, když naše góly zařídili Hlavsa a Průša. Poté jsme přesvědčivě zválcovali Mariánskou poměrem 5:0. Trefili se dvakrát Jirků a Hejtmánek, svůj druhý gól v turnaji vsítil také Hlavsa. V posledním zápase nám do finále stačil bod, ovšem trápení v zakončení nebralo konce, a tak jsme s rumburským gymnáziem prohráli 0:2. Čekal nás souboj o bronz s Karolínou Světlou.

V zápase jsme vedli díky dalekonosné střele brankáře Veroňka, avšak Karolínka rychle otočila. V posledních vteřinách nás zachránil Průša a šlo se do penalt. Až v šesté sérii soupeř penaltu neproměnil a naši šestou v řadě dal s přehledem Škvrna.

Děkujeme za vzornou reprezentaci školy této sestavě: Veroněk – Švihlík, Jirků, Průša, Hlavsa, Hejtmánek, Margala, Škvrna.

Střední zdravotnická škola a Obchodní akademie Rumburk na FB:

Futsalový turnaj a skvělé výsledky našich týmů! Včera naši kluci vybojovali 1. místo z 9 mužstev a holky obsadily krásné 2. místo z 5 týmů! Oběma týmům gratulujeme a děkujeme za skvělou reprezentaci naší školy!

Další disciplínou bude šplh v pátek 4. 12. 2026 v tělocvičně gymnázia Rumburk.
